author: Raykael
quote:
13 years of waiting to get a game that does not even hit stable 30fps in the best hardware available at launch (and this is also something worth talking about: who launces exclusively on consoles when the best performance you can get out of a PS5 PRO is 30 fps that are not even stable across the board?). 

The gameplay is pathetically slow, there are bugs that will make you question your sanity (prepare to see your character clip under the terrain A LOT). 

All of this for the single most expensive game ever launched? 

99, critics? Really? Guess we know now where all the developer's budget went. 

What a joke
